findings.text: follow-on: the comment marking the retired default cites the commit sha 6d99b59ba (repeated at :64), introduced by the same change; the repository naming rule keeps transient commit references out of comments, and the mechanism (the PNG is retired, the component breakdown is carried by per-trip-components.csv) reads the same without the sha.

follow-on: the head gate log's first line names REVISION=6d99b59ba (the pre-repair parent) while it measured the repaired working tree committed as 986b1a138, so a reader tying the 3-total/0-in-scope count to a revision is pointed at the wrong commit; the content reproduces at 986b1a138, so the count stands, but the recorded revision does not name the revision measured.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit 986b1a138 against 6d99b59ba and the node's whole landing b12cb22cc..986b1a138; 14 files change, 43 retired path keys drop from 11 receipts, two generator defaults are touched, four sentences of the landed record are reworded, and no numeric value changes.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names a src/href scan at the node head reporting zero uncited files plus the deletions listed in the report; the manifest records its sha/gate logs and I reproduced the scan at 986b1a138 (logs/head-src-scan-review.log): FIGURES=26 CITED=26 UNCITED=0.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to give every millisecond-converged-solve figure a receipt-backed citation or retire it, and commit 986b1a138 completes that by removing the last committed references to the 41 figures retired at 6d99b59ba.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it reports the repair landed in 986b1a138, the deleted-reference scan contracting from 44 in-scope hits at base 6d99b59ba to 0 at head, and names its logs.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths (docs/figures/millisecond-converged-solve, docs/evidence/archive/millisecond-converged-solve-landed.html, benchmarks/trip_quantum_width_one.py, the report and the fragment); every path in commit 986b1a138 is inside them.

justifications.durability: no test guards the receipt-path discipline — the deleted-reference scan lives in the run directory (figure-deleted-reference-scan.py), so nothing in the repository suite reddens if a receipt later regains a retired path.
justifications.evidence: I reproduced both gates at 986b1a138 — the src/href scan reads FIGURES=26 CITED=26 UNCITED=0 and the retired-reference scan reads 3 total / 0 in-scope against 47 total / 44 in-scope at 6d99b59ba — but the head gate logs carry REVISION=6d99b59ba (the pre-repair parent) in their header rather than the measured head.
justifications.fit: the receipt pruning and the generator repoint match the surrounding docs/figures idiom, but per_trip_kernel_breakdown.py:62,64 adds a comment citing the commit sha 6d99b59ba, a transient provenance reference the repository naming rules keep out of source.
justifications.goal_fidelity: 986b1a138 answers all three prior findings — condition_discriminator_trace.py:51 now defaults to the renamed discriminator PNG, the receipts no longer name the deleted panels, and landed.html:834/:962/:972/:1093 no longer name a retired SVG twin.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in 986b1a138 sits under docs/figures/millisecond-converged-solve or docs/evidence/archive/millisecond-converged-solve-landed.html, both inside the declared write paths.
